ok.description:
For `session/setContextTier`: whether the request was applied.
Always `true` for `model/contextCapability`.

state.description:
`"unknown"` (no provider metadata yet), `"single"` (one fixed window)
or `"tiered"`.

tiers.description: The tiers the model offers, smallest first. Empty unless known.

preferredTier.description: The tier the provider's catalog marks as preferred, when it does.

requested.description:
The tier requested for this model (session, then saved preference).
`None` means unset: the provider's reported window is used as before.

effective.description: The tier the effective window belongs to, when known.

effectiveWindow.description: The context window used for budgeting, fit checks and compaction.

windowSource.description: Where the effective window came from (`live`, `catalog`, `tier`, …).

note.description: Why the request is not in effect, or why a set was refused.

description:
Result of `model/contextCapability` and `session/setContextTier`.

Keeps the requested tier, the effective tier and the effective window
apart: a request the model cannot honour is reported as requested with no
effective tier and a `note`, never as success.
title: ContextCapabilityResult

contextWindow.description: The tier's context window in tokens, from provider metadata.

ContextTierOption.description: One selectable context tier of a model.
